In addition to providing public comment in person at the meeting, the following opportunity
has been established:

Public Comment
Please email all public comment on items on this agenda only to cityclerk@sgch.org and
include the following on the subject line of your email: PUBLIC COMMENT: 03/01/2022 Special
Meeting. The Clerk will read public comment into the record for up to the three-minute limit.
Words that would disrupt the meeting, including profanity, obscenity, and discriminatory
language, will not be read.

Watch the Meeting Online

Persons with Disabilities. Upon request, this Agenda will be made available in appropriate

Questions about this Agenda? Should any person have a question concerning any of the

MINUTES OF MARCH 1, 2022
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Vice Mayor Ding called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at
  5:30 P.M. on Tuesday, March 1, 2022, in the Padilla Room, 324 S. Mission Drive, San
  Gabriel, California, 91776.

  ROLL CALL
  Council Members Present:  John R. Harrington, Denise Menchaca, Carina Rivera,
  John Wu, and Vice Mayor Tony Ding.
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto, City Attorney Keith
  Lemieux, and Chief City Clerk Sharon Clark.

  1. CLOSED SESSION

  A. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION(§ 54957)

I  Title: City Attorney

  There was no public comment and no reportable action.

  B. ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 6:29 P.M.

  Respectfully submitted:

  Approved this 15th day of March, 2022:

I  ~~,
  TONY DING,  M~vt
